findings.precise_issue: The phrase ritual offerings of the body leaves the offering’s imagined nature unstated and permits a literal bodily-sacrifice reading. The frozen transcript supports the doctrine but does not make that qualifier explicit at the cited locator.

inspected_support.support: Connects bodily charity and fear with self-cherishing and analysis of inherent existence.
Explicitly defines the bodily feast offering as visualization.

proposed_repair.proposed_card: Chöd is a Buddhist offering practice directed at cutting self clinging. In Lama Zopa’s teaching, visualized offerings of the body to spirits are connected with examining the apparently inherent self. Fear becomes an occasion to investigate that self’s supposed independent existence.
